title: Unused Layout
description: Unused-code rule — layouts no script, button or file option navigates to. Layouts in the layout menu are entry points: they are listed separately and are not findings. Review: layouts opened only by name can appear here. Findings in files exported without DDR info are marked unverified.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Unreferenced layouts still load themes and objects and slow the solution.
rule.remediation: Confirm the layout is not opened by name / manually, then delete it. In a file exported without DDR info formula references are missing, so its findings are marked unverified — export it again with DDR info before deleting.
